synthesizedFacts.fact: Salicylic acid is a beta-hydroxy acid (BHA) that works as a chemical exfoliant, promoting the elimination of dead skin cells and is effective for treating blackheads and whiteheads.
Benzoyl peroxide is effective in reducing acne-causing bacteria and is best for treating red, pus-filled pimples (pustules).
Salicylic acid can significantly reduce comedones, but benzoyl peroxide may cause more irritation, especially in sensitive skin.
Both salicylic acid and benzoyl peroxide can cause dryness and irritation, and should not be used together on the same area of skin.
